scope: Standing former municipal palace used by the Museum of Antioquia in Medellín, including the Carabobo entrance, present exterior and open courtyard elevations.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: Section 2.1.2 documents three levels and a semibasement, five ranges enclosing two principal courts, an axial tall entry, projected bays and openings, Art Deco brickwork and render, and terraced walks on three sides.
The restoration contractor documents the reuse of the former municipal palace and the restoration of the four facades.
The municipal heritage inventory identifies the palace as Art Deco and documents the conservation work.
